types.name: Word that fits the meaning
types.description: A passage blank where all four options are the same part of speech (nouns, verbs or adjectives) and only one fits the meaning and logic of the passage.

types.name: Word that goes with its neighbour
types.description: A passage blank where the options are near-synonyms and the right one is decided by the word next to it (a fixed pair such as make a decision, known for, pay attention).

types.name: Verb form and tense
types.description: A passage blank whose options are different forms of the same verb (opens / opened / opening / was opened) or different tenses.

types.name: Connector
types.description: A passage blank whose options are joining words such as but, and, so, because, although, while, however, therefore.

types.name: Preposition
types.description: A passage blank whose options are prepositions such as in, on, at, of, for, with, by, from.

types.name: Article, pronoun or quantifier
types.description: A passage blank whose options are articles (a, an, the), pronouns (it, they, which, who) or quantifiers (much, many, few, little, some, any).
